title: IEBC constituency allocation shares for county valuation totals
citation: KNBS NAPR 2024/2025, Economic Survey 2025, KPHC 2019; NDMA bulletins 2019-21; KAMIS; AFA Yearbook 2025; HCD HVR 2022; Behnke & Muthami 2011 (audited); Field 1985; Kuria et al. 2016; Thiakunu et al. 2024; MapSPAM 2020.

method: share_j = w_j / county sum. Livestock and products: KPHC 2019 by constituency (census sub-county -> IEBC crosswalk). Crops and horticulture: MapSPAM 2020 physical area. weight_fallback = land-area shares where the prior is zero.
